data.name: Marshals of War: Orcblood
data.detailed_description:
Marshals of War: Orcblood is a solo and co-op RTS game featuring fantasy heroes and armies. Build strongholds, cast spells, fight bosses, loot treasure and upgrade in the battle against orcs and their masters.

Command Powerful Heroes

Control legendary warriors with unique abilities. Slam enemies, heal allies, or turn the tide with devastating spells.

Battle Challenging Bosses

Face off against towering enemies and ancient monsters with unique attack patterns and mechanics. Use teamwork and strategy to bring them down and claim what they guard.

Loot, Upgrade, Repeat

Collect gold, steel, and other resources from fallen foes, enemy bases and hidden caches. Upgrade your heroes and units between missions to customize your playstyle and gain the edge in tougher battles.

Lead Vast Armies

Strategically control footmen, archers, cavalry, and more. Exploit weaknesses, protect your support units, and dominate the battlefield.

Build & Protect

Fortify your bases, manage reinforcements, and secure vital resources while sabotaging your enemies.

Explore a Rich Fantasy World

Battle across vibrant stylized landscapes filled with orcs, elves, dwarves, and humans in a world brimming with mystery and magic.

Multiple Factions & Heroes

Choose from distinct races and subfactions. Customize your army and heroes with unique powers and gear.

Game Modes for Every Commander

  • Single-player Campaign: Learn the ropes and uncover the lore.

  • Co-op Arcade Mode: Create your loadout, earn epic loot, and fight through replayable mini-campaigns.

Are you ready to lead? The realm calls for a marshal.

data.short_description: Command powerful heroes and epic armies in Marshals of War: Orcblood, a stylized fantasy action Real Time Strategy game. Cast spells, defeat bosses, loot treasure, build defenses, and lead men, dwarves and elves to victory, in solo, or co-op against the orcs and their masters.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game is set in a fantasy medieval world where the player controls heroes and soldiers. The player engages in battles and may kill or dispatch enemies such as humans, orcs, animals and fantasy beasts, using medieval weapons such as swords and bows, as well as magic like fire. The game shows minor blood effects and death animations. Any violence is normally seen from a far distance. Players may purchase and consume items like wine and ale. Game text can contain mild profanity such as bastard, damn, or piss.
